tagline: 宾得取景器相机，1984 年发布
description: 宾得于1984年推出的取景器相机。配备38mm 1:3.8 pentax lens, 3 elments, 3 lens group-composition。快门速度Fixed, 1/125s。使用Manual, thumbwheel on rear。感光度100, 200 & 400 ASA。Fixed, range 1.5m to infinity。

specs.电池: 2xAA alkaline (not NiCd). Good for 360 flash discharges with new manganese alkali batteries
specs.英文简介: Plastic fixed focus compact 35mm camera with built in flash from Pentax.
